if nums.isEmpty then 0
  else
    let n := nums.length
    Id.run do
      let mut dp : Array Nat := Array.mkArray n 1

      for i in [1:n] do
        for j in [0:i] do
          if nums[j]! < nums[i]! && dp[j]! + 1 > dp[i]! then
            dp := dp.set! i (dp[j]! + 1)

      maxInArray dp

def maxInArray (arr : Array Nat) : Nat :=
  arr.foldl (fun a b => if a ≥ b then a else b) 0
